title: Kilimanjaro: Twenty Frequently Asked Questions
excerpt: Twenty frequently asked questions about climbing Kilimanjaro, with short answers and links to more detail.
body:
## How high is Kilimanjaro?
5,895 m (Uhuru Peak).

## Do I need climbing experience?
No. See [for beginners](/blog/kilimanjaro-for-beginners/).

## How many days?
Seven to nine. See [how many days](/blog/how-many-days-kilimanjaro/).

## Best route?
See [which route](/blog/best-kilimanjaro-route-for-you/).

## Best time?
See [best time](/blog/best-time-to-climb-kilimanjaro/).

## Minimum age?
10 for the summit.

## Is it dangerous?
Altitude is the main risk. See [altitude sickness](/blog/kilimanjaro-altitude-sickness/).

## Showers?
No; bowls of warm water.

## Toilets?
Private toilet tents on most climbs, plus park toilets.

## Charging?
Bring power banks.

## Phone signal?
In some places.

## What do we eat?
See [food on the mountain](/blog/kilimanjaro-food-on-the-mountain/).

## Packing?
See [packing list](/blog/kilimanjaro-packing-list/).

## Rent gear?
Yes, often.

## How cold?
Below freezing on the summit.

## Training?
See [training plan](/blog/kilimanjaro-training-plan/).

## Tips?
See [tipping](/blog/kilimanjaro-tipping-guide-crew/).

## Insurance?
See [insurance](/blog/kilimanjaro-travel-insurance/).

## Cost?
See [cost explained](/blog/kilimanjaro-cost-explained/).

## How do I book?
[Plan your climb](/travel-proposal/).
